title: WPA Historical RSS Source Registry Recovery

provenance.source_commit_message: Create index.html / Add WPA Diplomatic Analysis Lab — 1035 RSS sources

policy.purpose: Recover the historical 1035-source Diplomatic Analysis Lab inventory for controlled re-validation and selective promotion into WPA Watch.
policy.activation_rule: No record is active merely because it existed historically. Promotion requires a current successful RSS/Atom validation, HTTPS where available, provenance review, and WPA Watch health-gate compatibility.
exclusions: No automatic promotion to canonical or active status
